inlines.v: EXEM'PLIFY, verb transitive egzem'plify. [from exemplar; Low Latin exemplo.] 1. To show or illustrate by example. The life and conversation of our Savior exemplified his doctrines and precepts. 2. To copy; to transcribe; to take an attested copy. 3. To prove or show by an attested copy.
